info.name: ZATCA Gateway
info.description:
Admin JWT APIs (Phase 2) + vendor sk_* onboard APIs (Phase 3).

**Flow**
1. Auth → Login (saves `admin_token`)
2. Vendors → Create (saves `vendor_id`)
3. API Keys → Generate (saves `api_key` once)
4. Tax Payers → Create (saves `tax_payer_id`)
5. Onboard → Create CSR with `api_key`, then Start Onboard with OTP from Fatoora portal

Error envelope: `{ "error": { "type", "code", "message", "zatca_code" } }`

7. Standard invoices and 8. Simplified invoices — words for every choice, no taxPayerId or documentNumber. See plan/phase-four-api.md.

Vendor key (`vendor_api_key`) creates tax payers in folder 4b. Tax payer key (`taxpayer_api_key`) creates invoices in folders 7 and 8.

Tax payer key also calls POST {{base_url}}/v1/taxpayers/onboard/csr (folder 5b), then standard and simplified invoices (folders 7 and 8).

request.description: Returns JWT for ADMIN routes. Saves `admin_token` to the environment.
Soft-delete. `409 vendor_has_tax_payers` if tax payers still exist.

response.name: 409 Has tax payers

request.description: Vendor key (no taxPayerId). Plaintext returned once and saved as `vendor_api_key` and `api_key`. Use it for folder 4b (create tax payers) and folder 5 (onboard).

Tax payer key. Saved as `taxpayer_api_key` for folders 7 and 8. Does not replace the vendor key. Prefix must match the tax payer environment: sk_sandbox_ developer portal, sk_test_ simulation, sk_live_ production. Plaintext is returned once.

item.name: 3b. API Keys (vendor key)
item.description: The vendor creates keys with `vendor_api_key`. No vendor id in the path. Omit taxPayerId for another vendor key. Set taxPayerId for the invoice key used by folders 5b, 7, and 8.

request.description: Another vendor key. Saved as `vendor_api_key`. Plaintext is returned once.
Key for one tax payer. Saved as `taxpayer_api_key`. Prefix must match that tax payer environment.
Keys for this vendor only. The secret is not returned.
Revokes a key owned by this vendor.

Identity maps to CSR `csr.*` fields (env vars).

| API field | CSR property | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vatNumber | csr.organization.identifier | 399999999900003 |
| legalName | csr.organization.name | Maximum Speed Tech Supply LTD |
| organizationUnitName | csr.organization.unit.name | Riyadh Branch |
| locationAddress | csr.location.address | RRRD2929 |
| industryBusinessCategory | csr.industry.business.category | Supply activities |
| invoiceType both | csr.invoice.type | 1100 |

Server sets `country=SA` (`csr.country.name`), `status=draft`. On Create CSR, server also builds `csr.common.name` and `csr.serial.number`.

item.name: 4b. Tax payers (vendor key)
item.description: The vendor creates and manages tax payers with `vendor_api_key`. There is no vendor id in the path or body. The ZATCA environment comes from the key prefix.

request.description: Creates a tax payer for the vendor on this key. Saves `tax_payer_id`.

item.name: Create API key for this tax payer

request.description: Issues a key bound to {{tax_payer_id}}. Saved as `taxpayer_api_key`. The tax payer must belong to this vendor. Prefix must match the tax payer environment.

item.name: List API keys for this tax payer

request.description: Keys issued for this tax payer. Secrets are not returned.
Only tax payers owned by the vendor on this key.
404 when the id belongs to another vendor.
Updates a tax payer owned by this vendor.
Soft-delete. 404 when the tax payer is not this vendor's.

item.name: 5. Onboard /v1 (sk_* or ADMIN JWT)
item.description: Use `Authorization: Bearer {{api_key}}` (`sk_test_` / `sk_live_`). Admin JWT also works. Test keys → simulation only.

request.description: Async **202**. Enqueues BullMQ worker: compliance CSID → 6 samples → PCSID. Set `otp` from Fatoora after registering the CSR.
Progress only — no OTP, PEM, CSR, or CSID. Status: `queued` → `running` → `onboarded` | `failed`.
Async **202**. Requires `onboarded`. New CSR → renew → compliance samples → new PCSID.

response.name: 409 not_onboarded

item.name: 5b. Onboard (tax payer key)
item.description: The tax payer key (`taxpayer_api_key`) onboards itself. No tax payer id in the path. The same key is used for folder 7 (standard invoices) and folder 8 (simplified invoices).

request.description: Sync. Empty body. CSR is built from this tax payer. Register the PEM in Fatoora and copy the OTP.
202. Compliance CSID, samples, then production CSID for this tax payer.
Progress for the tax payer on this key.
202. Renews the production CSID for this tax payer.

item.name: 7. Standard invoices
item.description: Clearance. Use an API key generated for one tax payer. documentNumber is assigned by the gateway. Authorization is the tax payer key (`taxpayer_api_key`).
